2026-07-29.patch_summary: This patch removes the legacy ->iomap_begin()/->iomap_end() path in the iomap code, as all in-tree filesystems have implemented the ->iomap_next() function. The patch updates the iomap_iter function to use the ->iomap_next() function directly and removes the corresponding flags from the iomap_ops structure. This change simplifies the iomap code and reduces complexity.
